name: Potato Axis Spatial Model
purpose: A mathematical coordinate model for visualizing the canonical Frame without changing the canonical tree order.

spine.meaning: The continuous vertical Axis/Spine through the entire structure.

envelope.meaning: A smooth enclosing potato silhouette. It is a visualization envelope, not a third ontological space.

planes.intersection_rule: A node is on a plane when |n·p-d| is below the interaction tolerance.

nodes.placement: Deterministic coordinates derived from canonical level index and child index; repository IDs remain the identity.
nodes.principle: Spatial position is a visualization coordinate, never a replacement for the repository graph.

interaction.relationships: rendered as graph edges when both endpoints are spatially placed

interpretation: This is a geometric embedding of the repository's symbolic graph. It does not assert that spiritual or material space are physical scientific objects.
